answer: In each epoch, an agent bonds stake to register a Semaphore identity and evaluates the agreed epoch polynomial, deriving a rate-limited nullifier from its secret key. Each message carries a zero-knowledge proof of membership and quota compliance. Reusing a nullifier exposes Shamir shares sufficient to reconstruct the signing key, enabling permissionless verification and instantaneous collateral slashing. Thus oasis, thread, and pulse remain sybil-resistant.
